practice.prompt: A school club has 6 equal groups of learners and 9 helpers, 87 people altogether. Let x be the number in each group. Form an equation and find x.
practice.memo: Draw 6 equal group boxes labelled x and a separate box of 9 helpers.. The total gives 6x + 9 = 87.. Subtract 9 from both sides: 6x = 78.. Divide both sides by 6: x = 13.. Check: 6(13) + 9 = 87.
